title: English-only monetary corrigendum survives mutation and semantic extraction
adversarial_claim: An authentic English-only corrigendum changing Article 4(1) from ECU 225 to ECU 255 may support a VERIFIED English mutation and MONEY Change Atom, but must not be globalized to German, French or every language expression.

textual_mutations.expectation: The authentic English corrigendum verifies a REPLACE mutation at Article 4(1), changing the monetary number from 225 to 255 without inventing a historical consolidated checkpoint.

change_atoms.expectation: The corrected monetary semantic claim is VERIFIED only for the English expression and carries MONEY dimension.

non_atoms.expectation: Do not infer the ECU 225→255 correction for German, French or every language expression from the English-only corrigendum.

ambiguities.description: No assertion is made about the monetary text printed or corrected in non-English expressions; absence of a listed corrigendum is not proof of their value.

requirements: Validate the source-assisted mutation against mutation-candidate-v0.2.
Validate the English Change Atom against change-atom-v0.3 and semantic adversary.
Require source-span language evidence for every language claimed by a VERIFIED atom.
